captions.detailed: A rear de Dion suspension axle assembly featuring a dark-colored, rectangular chassis mounting beam and a curved, tapered transverse axle tube. Running through the axle tube are two independent, rotating half-shafts terminated with metallic grey wheel hubs. The chassis mount is fixed, while the internal half-shafts and external wheel hubs are designed to rotate continuously around their respective lateral axes.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a rear de Dion tube axle assembly. The model must feature a fixed rectangular chassis mount, a curved transverse axle tube, and two independent, continuously rotating half-shafts inside the tube, ending in grey wheel hubs.
captions.factory: The model is built by defining a fixed base part consisting of a rectangular chassis block and a curved axle tube. The axle tube is created using a loft or swept-like configuration of cylinders and cones. Left and right half-shafts are modeled as cylinders and added as child parts with continuous rotational joints. Finally, cylindrical wheel hubs are attached to the ends of the half-shafts as child parts, also with continuous rotational joints.
